gloss: to dismiss; to remove from office

definitions.gloss: to dismiss; to remove from office; to relieve of duties
definitions.explanation: To officially remove someone from a position of responsibility, typically a managerial, executive, or public role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{解任|かいにん}された。
⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解任|かいにん}する⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{採択|さいたく}→採択：06784_saitaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A resolution to remove the director was adopted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦{不振|ふしん}→不振：07771_fushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{解任|かいにん}された⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同情|どうじょう}→同情：11954_doujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The manager was dismissed due to poor results, but there were also sympathetic voices from the fans.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{解任|かいにん}→解任：17173_kainin⟧ (dismissal; removal from office) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. A formal term used primarily in corporate governance and sports management. In news headlines, the passive form {解任|かいにん}される is very common, especially for sports managers and corporate executives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解任|かいにん}する: to dismiss a manager/coach
- ⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解任|かいにん}する: to remove a company director
- ⟦{解任|かいにん}→解任：17173_kainin⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: demand for dismissal
- ⟦{解任|かいにん}→解任：17173_kainin⟧⟦{動議|どうぎ}→動議：09762_dougi⟧: motion for removal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fire; to dismiss — used for regular employees, while ⟦{解任|かいにん}→解任：17173_kainin⟧ is for people in appointed positions
- ⟦{罷免|ひめん}→罷免：29397_himen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to impeach and dismiss — more formal, used for government officials removed through official proceedings
- ⟦{更迭|こうてつ}→更迭：07969_koutetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace; to reshuffle — emphasizes the replacement aspect rather than the removal
